_comments.devDependencies.jsdom: Root has no tests of its own — this exists only so npm hoists jsdom to the same node_modules level as the shared vitest package. Without it, vitest's internal bare import('jsdom') can't resolve (extension's jsdom devDependency stays nested instead of hoisting), silently dropping the 2 jsdom-environment test files from extension's suite. Do not remove as 'unused'. See commit 95951c5.
